# gld_p2d_spec.txt - psnProgramToDecoded(decodedProgram, record): `*decodedProgram` records of 0x48 bytes are decoded; byte fields of each record (offsets 0x4c..0x8a) index the tables at 0x1dc04c / 0x1dc098 / 0x1dc0d8 / 0x1dc158 / 0x1dc198 (stock `lwzx` / `lhz` with index*4: 0x1dc0d8 holds 32 entries, 0x1dc158 16, 0x1dc098 16, 0x1dc04c 16); a byte beyond the table reads neighbouring data.
# The spec decodes 1 or 2 records and keeps every byte of them in 0..15 (each word is one of eight values with all four bytes <= 15; a gfield_t type holds at most 96 fields, so one pick per word, not one u8 per byte) to test the claim that the differences are table-index artifacts; it shrinks every record byte, so it is a test of the claim, not a coverage run.

  randfill 0x00 0x400 65536
